main_text.l: stupidum & stolidum significare ac intelligere
soleant:idq; propterea credo, quod nemo illis,
nisi stupidus & stolidus, ad Chimæras papales
credendas aptus & idoneus videatur.
Hæc mihi fere in mentem veniebant, quæ
tuo excitatus, & nescio quomodo illuminatus
sermone, dicenda putarem de Societate Iesu,
deq; suis, quæ ipsa præcipuè colit & veneratur,
idolis. Tum Paulus fortibus me oculis intu-
ens, Non quæram, inquit, posthac amplius
tantæ cæcitatis Iesuiticæ causas, excusationes
non recipiam: si in te potuit tantum veritatis
lumen institutione Iesuitica deprauari, ac pro-
pemodum, nisi ipse, credo, huc diuinitus ve-
nissem, extingui; quid ego in obscuris & tene-
bricosis aliorum animis non fieri existimem?
Quæ cum dixisset, finitæ signum nostræ recrea-
tionis dabatur, & vterq; nostrum com-
presso, ut fit, sermone, in suum se
cubiculum recepit.

page.notes: Ornaments (fleurons) above and below the text omitted as non-text. Doubtful readings: "soleant" (printed with a long s, read as "foleant" by the scan); "recreationis" joined across the line break without a visible hyphen; "com-presso" hyphen at line end as printed. Printed "Iesuitica" and "Iesuiticæ" kept as printed.
